LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsEnvoyMajorTree_Report: A kingdom war-envoy arrived, carrying a major arms order.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_Greeting: I am a war-envoy of Rakinia. Your reputation as an armorer has reached the court, {Interviewer_labelShort}. The kingdom requires your finest steel—a proper order, not a common request.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_Terms1: The terms are plain: deliver five longswords of "Excellent" quality or better, within the set time. The kingdom offers 450 silver and a single-use "Kingdom Conscription Writ"—one paper, one call, one host of our fighters at your side.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_Terms2: The army stirs for war. Only work from a master like you is fit for their hands. Complete this well, and your name will be recorded in the court scrolls—a matter of honor, not just coin.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_OptBack: Back to the matter at hand
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_Sealed: The envoy folds the sealed contract with care. "The war-detail will come to inspect on the appointed day. Do not disappoint the kingdom."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_ArmsMajor_Envoy_MsgAccept: You have accepted a major arms contract: deliver 5 longswords of Excellent quality or better to the kingdom war-detail.
